question: Which singer performed in the greatest number of different concerts?
reference_sql: SELECT s.Name FROM singer AS s JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID GROUP BY s.Singer_ID, s.Name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sic.concert_ID) DESC LIMIT 1
candidate_sql:
SELECT s.Singer_ID, s.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM singer AS s
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = CAST(s.Singer_ID AS VARCHAR)
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID, s.Name
QUALIFY DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sic.concert_ID) DESC) = 1
evaluation_evidence: Candidate results differ from the reference results.
